hook.text: Flat Earth, faked moon landings, and lizard people — millions believe these. They're not all uneducated.

buildup.text: Conspiracy theories offer simple explanations for complex events by attributing them to secret powerful groups.

discovery.text: They thrive when trust in institutions is low. Conspiracy fills the void that lost trust creates.

twist.text: Believing one conspiracy makes you more likely to believe others. They form interconnected belief networks.

climax.text: Conspiracy theories aren't just wrong beliefs. They're frameworks that explain away any contradicting evidence.

punchline.text: When proof against the theory proves the conspiracy, reason has exited.

quiz.question: Why do conspiracy theories thrive when institutional trust is low?
options: Conspiracy theories fill the void that lost trust creates
Low trust means more accurate information
